answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the grove is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A opal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the falcon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
